HPS Bare-Metal Reference

Use this reference to look up public API declarations, parameter descriptions, types and low-level driver details. For application call order, prerequisites and worked examples, use the linked README for each module in the API Guide Index.

Finding an API

  • Start with the API Guide Index to choose a module and open its key symbols.

  • Expand Public API in the menu to browse headers. These are the declarations used by applications.

  • Expand Technical Driver Reference for controller registers and implementation details.

  • Use symbol search when you know a function or type name.

Building and Booting

Start with README.md in the root of the repository for the DDR and OCRAM build and boot instructions. Select PLAT=agilex5 or PLAT=agilex3 and use the matching board artifacts. PLAT has no default; always specify PLAT and BUILD_MODE for the intended platform and boot mode. The generated API reference does not establish hardware validation of these procedures.

About This Reference

Function and type topics are generated from the source comments under api/ and drivers/. Generation checks that the documentation can be processed; it does not establish that a declaration matches the implementation or that hardware operation has been qualified. Files without recognized topics are omitted because Documented Only is enabled.
